en:
Looks like we're all here. 
So, where's this manhole?
Umm... Over there, in grass.
So there's even grass out here...
Ah, be careful of the roots, everybody...

So a manhole was hidden in a place 
like this, huh?

Well, you can't hide stuff from the eyes of 
Kaito Momota, Luminary of the Stars!
<CLT=cltMIND>But Gonta found it...

Now's not the time to be shouting 
and celebrating...

Even if this really is the exit, 
it's all over if Monokuma catches us.
I agree. We need to be quick about this.

We should investigate the
manhole right away.

If it is an exit, it's only a matter of time
until Monokuma comes for us.
What wrong? Manhole in grass over there.

Whoa, look at all these weeds. This place
could definitely use a groundskeeper.
Right, Kee-boy!?

Why are you telling me that? Furthermore...
I would prefer you address me as "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Keebo<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
But you can pull weeds. Right, Kee-boy?

I can do all sorts of things just as well
as any person!

As well as any person...?
But...you're not a person.

Th-That's discrimination...
Robophobic discrimination...

Why say you can do things as well as any
person when you're *clearly* not a person?

The ground opens up before us, 
as though inviting us downward...

Once we are swallowed by darkness, will we 
be able to return to the light...? Kehehe...
...There is a monitor here, too.

That aside, this is a rather remote location
to install a communication device...

...It's a pointless expenditure, wouldn't you
agree?
What purpose does this facility serve?

One would assume that all this greenery
would interfere with the machinery...

Does this mean preparations were not
completed before we arrived?

Down the manhole, huh...? Do you think 
there are creepy creatures down there?
What's there to be afraid of!?

Even if the rats are as big as cats, Himiko
can just blast them away with her magic!

That's not possible... If I use my magic down 
there, the entire passage might explode.
Ooh! Your magic is so powerful!

Well then, though I may be unworthy, I will
protect you, Himiko!
Mhm, I'll leave it to you...

I don't really feel like it...
But I guess we gotta investigate this place...

...Hurry up. Don't you want to escape from
here?

Though it's hidden by grass, there's definitely
a manhole over there!

Typical degenerate male! You peeping Toms
love to find things you weren't meant to see!

We need to be careful...or those monsters 
might appear again.

Nyeeeh... Are you feeling down? Do you want 
some magical powder to cheer you up?
It's...not a dangerous kind of powder, is it?

Wowww! It's like a super secret entrance!
I'm so excited!

Atua is just as excited as I am!
I know cuz He told me!

Quit wastin' my time, you kooky bitch!
Hurry up already! Chop-chop!

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a manhole in the grass?
We should investigate it.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a manhole in the grass?
We should investigate it.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's true... There really is a manhole in
the grass.

An important hole near some bush!?
Sounds familiar, am I right ladies!?

Awwww, this manhole cover looks heavy.
Can we even lift it?
I can try.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo placed his hands on the manhole
cover, and with all his strength he—
Grgh...! Grrrrrrrrrrrrgh...!
How embarrassing. It won't even budge.

Huhhh? A robot's not even strong enough
to move it?

Oh, don't worry. My physical strength is
approximate to that of a strong senior citizen.
Th-That's fuckin' pathetic!

Th-The professor did not want a repeat of the
tragedy that occurred during trial production.

Umm... Now I'm just plain curious about 
what happened during that trial...
Oh, then allow Gonta.

Gonta lift cover before to peek inside.
Should be able to pick up cover too.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta placed his hands on the manhole cover
and—
Upsy-daisy.
So easily!?

His strength...must be due to my magic. 
Yup...there's no mistaking it.
Ooohh! You're amazing, Himiko!
...What should Gonta do with cover now?

Please leave it somewhere else.
Be careful not to hit anyone with it.

Um, actually...Gonta no can do that...
Very rude to litter...

<CLT=cltMIND>But with nowhere to dispose of the manhole
cover, Gonta begrudgingly tossed it aside...

<CLT=cltMIND>The manhole cover easily traveled 5 yards
before it hit the ground.

Kehehe...what wonderful strength. You could
likely crush a child's skull with ease.

How ungentlemanly!
Gonta NEVER do that!
Gentleman or not, *no one* would do that!

But Gonta is sooo much more reliable than
some bean-counting robot.

Are you...talking about me? Because I can
count many things, not just beans.

<CLT=cltMIND>While everyone else was talking,
I slowly peeked into the manhole.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was too dark inside to see clearly, but...
I could feel cold, moist air drifting up from it.

Th-This place is kinda creepy...
We're really going in here?

I'm sure it's fine. At the very least, 
we definitely won't die down there.

If anything happens, I'll protect most of you!
But the degenerate males are on their own!
Then...Gonta protect menfolk.

Awfully quiet...
Where are Monokuma and the Monokubs?

I was certain they would show up at some 
point and crush us like rotten gnats...

Nyahahaha! They probably haven't noticed
yet!

Then let's hurry before they show up
to mess with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>One by one, we each descended down
into the manhole.
Mysterious Letters

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a manhole in the grass?
We should investigate it.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a manhole in the grass?
We should investigate it.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
The audio's gonna crack from so many speakers.
